latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of group-logger skill:

- Automatically logs LINE group messages containing specific keywords to a CSV file.
- Supports two modes: silent logging and summary on @mention.
- Summaries are generated per customer or job upon request.
- Daily automatic CSV backup included.
- Supports multiple groups; logs separated by group_id.
- No replies in logging mode to minimize message noise.
